CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

Subject matter'

This Regulation lays down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (1).

Article 2

Scope

1.

This Regulation applies to:

(a)

providers placing AI systems on the market;

(b)

deployers of AI systems.

▼M1

2.
This Regulation does not apply to AI systems for military purposes.

This sentence belongs to paragraph 2.

▼M1

Inserted rule

ANNEX I

High-risk areas

remote identification systems.
